name: Nightly Commitizen Bump

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # every day at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  bump:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0          # required for commitizen to see full history
          persist-credentials: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .[dev]   # installs dev deps including commitizen
          pip install commitizen

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        uses: pre-commit/action@v3.0.1
        with:
          extra_args: --all-files

      - name: Configure git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Run commitizen bump and changelog
        id: bump
        run: |
          # The --no-input flag skips interactive prompts
          cz bump --changelog --no-input
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check for changes
        id: changes
        run: |
          if git status --porcelain | grep -q .; then
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Push changes
        if: steps.changes.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git push

          pip install -e .[dev]   # installs dev deps including commitizen

        env:
